description: `aspire terminal attach` and `aspire terminal tape play` now resolve an exact resource instance ID instead of falling back to a numeric replica index or interactive picker, so commands always connect to the replica you named. Replicated resources require an exact instance ID (discoverable via `aspire ps` or `aspire describe`); the legacy `--replica`/`-r` numeric option remains hidden but functional for older scripts and VS Code extensions.
name: Terminal commands target exact resource instance IDs
